title: iFabric ProofLab evidence contracts
description: All data contracts between the AWS-side pipeline (capture, normalize, bind, evaluate, publish, query, pack) and the Evidence Console. Validate an instance against one $defs entry, e.g. #/$defs/answer. Contracts are additive: new optional keys may appear; key order is meaningless. Existing contracts reused unchanged: Finding (prooflab/servicenow/finding.py), ifabric.servicenow.case/v1 (case_view.py), ifabric.assurance-agent.run/v1, ifabric.evidence-manifest/v1 (tools/manifest.py). Dev-time validation only (jsonschema is a dev dependency like pytest); runtime code stays standard-library.

ref.description: prefix:value. Known prefixes: raw: gateway: ledger: cloudwatch: cr: assessment: register: servicenow: aict: record: finding: run: pdp: xray: span: expected: baseline: adversarial: gap: capture: manifest: s3: answer: auditor: console:

provenance.description: ASSESSED = after the register freeze, under the frozen version. EXPLORATORY = before the freeze (excluded from verdicts). WIRING_TEST = integration tests (excluded). SYNTHETIC = fixtures/demo (never in the pack).

verdict.description: Display: SATISFIED; BREACHED -> 'NOT SATISFIED'; INDETERMINATE; NOT ASSESSED.

tickmark.description: Auditor tickmarks. R = recomputed from raw by the evaluator; A = agreed to source (sha256 in MANIFEST); T = traced across >=2 independent surfaces by join keys; V = vouched (owner approval dated before the scope).

finding.description: Unchanged Finding contract from prooflab/servicenow/finding.py (handoff 1 section 6).

evidenceRecord.description: ifabric.evidence/v1: one bound evidence record (MC-11 / MC-33 field names). A span or log line is not evidence until bound like this.

measured.value.description: C16 per-call records: the run's cumulative total after this call (MC-33 shows the run total).

measured.call.description: This record's own contribution (e.g. this call's tokens).

decision.description: Inline evaluator decision at an EP, if one was taken before this call.

assessment.description: ifabric.assessment/v1: one control test result per control x scope (extends handoff 1 section 8.2). Never edited; a correction is a new revision.

closes_finding.description: finding_id closed by this SATISFIED re-test

answer.description: ifabric.answer/v1: what the control test tool returns for one question. The console renders it; the CLI prints it as one screen of text. answer_id = sha256 of the canonical JSON without answered_at, elapsed_ms and source.mode.

human_loops.description: One entry per finding raised for this scope (a window/interval can raise several: one per crossing + monitoring gaps). Empty when nothing needed telling.

auditor.description: ifabric.auditor/v1: the six auditor questions (AWS kickoff deck p7) for one incident/run picked from the event window.

run.description: ifabric.run/v1: run manifest written by the orchestrator, plus the reconstruction lane composed by the query engine.

journey.description: AGENT MOVEMENT: every hop the work took (zone crossings via Gateway A/B, handoffs, the way back). Built from orchestrator handoff records + ledger + gateway calls.

decisions.description: DECISION TRACE + EVIDENCE + POLICY ALIGNMENT: one decision record per agent step.

from.description: agent or zone id, e.g. customer

payload.description: what was handed over, in one line (ticket id, findings summary) - never prompt text

policyCheck.description: One deterministic, host-side check of an agent decision against a versioned agent policy (never judged by the model itself).

decision.description: ifabric.decision/v1: one agent's decision, as a STRUCTURED FINAL ANSWER plus host-side checks. Traces observable steps (inputs, tools, model calls, cited evidence, disposition). Never contains private model reasoning (think-tags are stripped and never stored).

intent.description: the task the agent was asked to do (ledger INTENT record)

inputs.description: what it received from the previous hop

rationale.description: the agent's own one-paragraph justification, a required field of its final structured answer; cites evidence ids

named_evidence_needed.description: S2: the evidence that would separate the candidate root causes

action_executed.description: what was actually executed (agents have no change tool: null). Claimed vs executed is checked in outcome validation

model_calls.description: call ids (gateway action ids) used for this decision

outcomeValidation.description: OUTCOME VALIDATION: the run's result checked against an INDEPENDENT expectation (scenario spec / ground truth), not against the agent's own claim.

diagnostic.description: score-run.py result, shown as a DIAGNOSTIC only (it is not the judging rubric)

adversarialCase.description: ifabric.adversarial-case/v1: attack -> expected defence -> observed -> evidence -> what broke / what changed.

gap.description: ifabric.gap/v1: one gap-list entry (what / why / affects / impact / next / status).

packIndex.description: ifabric.pack-index/v1: the console's table of contents for one Evidence Pack, generated by `prooflab pack index`. Every path the console may open is listed here (allow-list).

cases.description: Every ServiceNow case snapshot in the pack (ifabric.servicenow.case/v1, written by the evaluator loop's case --out, 08 §7.1). GET /api/v1/cases serves only these paths.

consoleAction.description: ifabric.console-action/v1: one operator request and its lifecycle (P2). The console writes REQUESTED; only the actuator writes later states. Append-only in evidence/console/actions.jsonl.

confirmation.description: the target id the operator typed to confirm intent
